Phthongos — Trucabulles
Application license: LICENSE (English translation); LICENSE_PHTHONGOS.md (French reference).
Third-party components retain their own licenses. Offline FR/EN credits and complete notices are available in the application.
components.json inventories the native package only. Optional model weights and the optional HQ bank are not bundled.
FluidSynth and libsndfile are unmodified, replaceable DLLs. Their verified corresponding-source archives and codec notices are retained alongside them.
The MuScriptor engine code and optional neural weights have separate licenses. No optional GGUF weights are included.
